typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	AdHoc_Run as boolean (),
	BEGIN_DT as timestamp (),
	Email_Recipients as string (),
	Email_Recipients_Failure as string (),
	END_DT as timestamp (),
	FileCount as integer (),
	FileName as string (),
	FileType as string (),
	FirstRunDayOfMonth as integer (),
	GRGR_CK as string (),
	ID_Number as integer (),
	InboundArchiveFilePath as string (),
	InboundFile as string (),
	InboundFileName as string (),
	InboundFilePath as string (),
	InboundFullFileName as string (),
	MarketName as string (),
	OutboundExtract as string (),
	OutputPath as string (),
	ReportDate as timestamp (),
	SecondRunDayOfMonth as integer (),
	SendToNourishedRxOutput as string (),
	Src_Query as string (),
	StoredProcName as string ()
}

source(output(
		HC_ID as string,
		NRxID as string,
		FirstName as string,
		LastName as string,
		DOB as date,
		OutreachOutcome as string,
		EligibilityStatus as string,
		EnrollmentStatus as string,
		ProgramStatus as string,
		NewEnrollment as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(SBSB_ID = HC_ID,
		FileName = $InboundFullFileName,
		MarketName = $MarketName,
		GRGR_CK = $GRGR_CK) ~> DerivedColumn
FlatFileSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCountAGGREGATE
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		MarketName as string,
		FirstName as string,
		GRGR_CK as integer,
		FileName as string,
		HC_ID as string,
		NewEnrollment as string,
		SBSB_ID as string,
		EligibilityStatus as string,
		EnrollmentStatus as string,
		DOB as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		LastName as string,
		OutreachOutcome as string,
		NRxID as string,
		ProgramStatus as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		MarketName,
		FirstName,
		GRGR_CK,
		FileName,
		HC_ID,
		NewEnrollment,
		SBSB_ID,
		EligibilityStatus,
		EnrollmentStatus,
		DOB,
		LastName,
		OutreachOutcome,
		NRxID,
		ProgramStatus)) ~> NourishedRxStageMember
RowCountAGGREGATE sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
